project.name: osgi/domains/cluster-pki/cluster-pki-contract
project.description: The cluster-pki domain contract. type=dual-realm, like incus-ingress-contract: the seal scion (OSGi) PRODUCES the deterministic cluster PKI and files it in the cellar; the host GROW (flat, outside Felix) FETCHES it and poses it on the instance's devlxd config — so the carried value types must live in BOTH realms. It holds the two @SeedContract records the seal stores (ClusterCaBundle — the sops-sealed CA bundle for the node; ClusterAgeKey — the cluster age identity that decrypts it), the ClusterPkiCoordinate they are filed under, and the OSGi-side SopsEncryptor seam the core drives (impl in cluster-pki-edge). All exported types depend only on the JDK + the seed-broker seam (provided, never embedded), satisfying the dual-realm library rule. See docs/architecture/cluster-api/deterministic-cluster-access.adoc.
